title: Dotonbori food guide: 13 places to eat in Osaka
desc: Where to eat along Dotonbori in Osaka, grouped by dish: takoyaki, okonomiyaki, beef, ramen, fugu and sweets.

items.title: Takoyaki Wanaka (わなか)
items.memo: Takoyaki shop with one of the widest flavour selections in the area.

items.title: Acchichi Honpo (あっちち本舗)
items.memo: Popular takoyaki stand on the Dotonbori strip.

items.title: Otako (本家大たこ)
items.memo: Takoyaki with very large octopus pieces in each ball.

items.title: Takoyaki Juhachiban (十八番)
items.memo: Takoyaki topped with crunchy tempura bits.

items.title: Ajinoya (味乃家)
items.memo: Well-known okonomiyaki spot; lighter style with less flour. Expect a queue.

items.title: Matsusakagyu Yakiniku M Hozenji Hanare
items.memo: Matsusaka beef yakiniku near Hozenji Temple.

items.title: Kushikatsu Daruma Dotonbori (だるま)
items.memo: Classic Osaka kushikatsu; look for the angry Daruma statue outside.

items.title: Osaka Ohsho (大阪王将)
items.memo: Gyoza chain, easy to spot by the giant gyoza on the front.

items.title: Kamukura Dotonbori (神座)
items.memo: Ramen chain with a range of bowls; open late.

items.title: Kinryu Ramen (金龍ラーメン)
items.memo: Ramen stand on the main strip, recognisable by its big dragon sign.

items.title: Takoyasu
items.memo: Smaller fugu (pufferfish) restaurant near Asashiobashi Station.

items.title: Naruto Taiyaki Hompo (鳴門鯛焼本舗)
items.memo: Taiyaki shop; a good place to try the fish-shaped cake.
